newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London static, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London static, trade thin.

text.p: Japanese shares in London were barely changed on Friday in thin trading, with some profit-taking in stocks of high-tech companies, traders said.
"It wasn't that exciting. We saw some selling in high tech stocks and that's all about it", one trader said.
The 225-share Nikkei average in Tokyo finished at 20,485.75, down 2.40 points or 0.01 percent at 20,485.75 in quiet trading as investors awaited Friday's U.S. payroll data.
